top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not know who they were responsible to pick up  on the day of the incident. As a result, the operation failed to pick up two children from elementary school.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this Minimum Standard. A caregiver utilized inappropriate language when referring to a child.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation it was found that children under 18 months were being grouped with children up to 3 years old during the morning opening hours.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.
